incidents.name: unverified_0x54Cd2346 fresh implementation drained 12 seconds after upgrade
incidents.notes: The implementation installed on the ERC1967 proxy one block earlier exposed selector 0x03b79c24(address) with no caller check, releasing the proxy's entire weETH balance to the supplied address, which the attacker immediately sold into the weETH/WETH Uniswap V3 pool for 114.5 WETH.

sources.ref: onchain review: ERC1967 proxy 0x54Cd23460DF45559Fd5feEaaDA7ba25f89c13525 created 2025-01-13T03:03:35Z by 0xbde590921e7666b0dc88e3b1dd50931c5cd2fb3b, not the attack-tx sender 0xb750e3165de458eae09904cc7fad099632860b0f. Seven EIP-1967 Upgraded events; the last, installing implementation 0xbc4b1d58b28c497b7afda6fb90fe1471fa0672cc, is in block 22855568 at 2025-07-05T21:03:23Z and was sent by admin 0x7e9b11d0aa215e0f1a7f62534c7c93fc340d493d (tx 0xcd4a637da42ef5db0b7b6a1592c99a594530852f91e806d8c12ce0b587579373) — a different party from the attacker. The drain lands in the very next block, so the executing code was 12 seconds old. Reported loss 285.7k USD.
